privacy_policy.text:
Privacy policy

Bella's Café respects your privacy. We collect your name and email when you order ahead, and use them only to prepare your order.

We use Intercom to answer customer messages on our website.

We keep order records for 12 months for accounting purposes. You can ask us to delete your data at any time by emailing hello@bellas-cafe.example.

Our website uses cookies to remember your basket.
